title: Outctl as the general context compression layer
body: Outctl is the general context-management layer required for all agent tool output. The current architectural role of outctl is context compression, context compression, context compression before command output reaches the agent. Outctl owns the context layer and the retrieval layer.
facts: outctl is the general context-management layer required for all agent tool output

title: Outctl as addressed command evidence
body: The current architectural role of outctl is an addressed command-evidence substrate. Native programmatic tool calling owns ephemeral orchestration and context filtering. Compression remains an optional presentation policy over durable evidence.
facts: outctl is an addressed command-evidence substrate
compression is an optional presentation policy

title: Measure the diagnosis, not only the transcript
body: The output reduction mechanism worked, while diagnostic quality, economics, and execution authority needed separate denominators. This note is evidence about the experiment rather than current architecture authority.
facts: the outctl experiment separated mechanism, quality, economics, and authority
